text:
Alice M.: Heads up — noticed a sustained increase in GPU queue saturation this morning on us-east-1-serving. Queue depth panels spiked and several autoscalers hit max replicas. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/dashboard/uid/abcd1234 :eyes:
Ben C.: saw that too. Was this correlated with the model-v2 rollout? deploy-bot shows a deploy at 09:02 UTC
deploy-bot: model-v2 rollout started 2025-11-02T09:02:11Z, canary -> 25% -> 50% now
Carla S.: yep model-v2 increases avg batch size (more tokens per request) so throughput per GPU dropped. We're seeing batch stuffing longer queues.
Alice M.: Can we tune alerts so we don't get pages for expected canary noise? Current alert is: ALERT GPU_Queue_Exceeded IF sum(gpu_queue_depth) > 200 for 5m
Ben C.: that one is noisy. Two ideas: (1) add a per-model label to the metric and only alert on sum by cluster where model != canary or (2) change to "for 10m" and include saturation ratio
Dan R.: adding saturation ratio is good. We have metrics: gpu_saturation{gpu,region} and gpu_capacity. Proposed PromQL for ratio:  sum(gpu_inflight_tokens) / sum(gpu_capacity_tokens)  — then alert when > 0.85 for 10m
Ben C.: here's a quick PromQL snippet I tested: 
```
sum(rate(gpu_inflight_tokens_total[1m])) by (cluster) / sum(gpu_capacity_tokens) by (cluster)
```
Trigger at > 0.82 for 15m given current noise
Carla S.: also consider splitting alerts: a hard SLO breach alert and a softer "headroom low" warning. Soft warning can go to #eng-infra only, hard breach pages on-call.
Eva L.: +1. Also: the batch size distribution changed because clients now send longer contexts. We should add a panel for median batch size and p95 latency per batch-size bucket. That will help correlate.
Alice M.: Good call. Can someone propose exact alert defs? I can add to PR once we agree.
Ben C.: Draft alert defs: 
```
- alert: GPU_Saturation_Warn
  expr: (sum(rate(gpu_inflight_tokens_total[1m])) by (cluster) / sum(gpu_capacity_tokens) by (cluster)) > 0.7
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: warning
- alert: GPU_Saturation_High
  expr: (sum(rate(gpu_inflight_tokens_total[1m])) by (cluster) / sum(gpu_capacity_tokens) by (cluster)) > 0.85
  for: 15m
  labels:
    severity: page
```
Carla S.: Make sure to add `on (cluster)` or `by (cluster)` alignment in the exprs so we don't compare across clusters with different capacity.
Dan R.: I'll add cluster scoping and also a `without (model)` clause to ignore canary-model label while canary is in rollout. Something like `unless on(cluster) (label_replace(deployment_info, "model", "", "model", "canary-.*"))` — need to verify exact label_replace syntax
Alice M.: Can we also reduce noise by excluding tiny bursts? e.g., require average queue > X over > Y windows instead of instant peaks.
Ben C.: that's what the `rate([...])` and the for: 10m solves. Also consider using `max_over_time` for short peaks: `max_over_time(queue_depth[5m])` to catch sustained bursts vs single spike
Eva L.: Related: update the dashboard doc with runbook steps: when saturation warning fires -> check p95 batch size, recent deploys, look at model label distribution on inflight tokens. I'll add a short checklist.
Carla S.: FYI I pushed an experimental panel with batch-size histogram to staging Grafana: panel uid: hist-batch-ss. Share feedback pls.
Alice M.: Thanks. Action items: Ben to open alert PR with cluster-scoped exprs + warning/page split; Dan to add label filter to exclude canary models; Eva to update dashboard runbook and add batch-size panel link; Carla will monitor canary and report back in 2 hours.
Ben C.: will do, aiming for a PR by EOD PT.
Dan R.: I'll test the label_replace and post the final expr in the PR.
Carla S.: monitoring:  I'll mute the noisy old GPU_Queue_Exceeded alert for the canary window so it doesn't page until new alerts land :mute: 
Alice M.: Great. If pages still come through after these changes, escalate to on-call. Thanks everyone :pray:
